verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUKAMA wange nkwebaza
Okundabirira;
Emmere n'eby'okwambala
Byonna biva gy'oli.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
ggwe wekka-onkuume mu kabi,
Era ne mu kufa;
Obulamu bwange bwonna
Buli mu galo zo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ontumire malayika
Ankuumire ddala;
Nneme-okuva mu maaso go
-Emisan n'ekiro.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ggwe wampa bakadde bange
Ne baganda bange;
Wampa n'emikwano gyange,
Bonna baava gy'oli.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Sirina kya kusasula,
Naye kye nkusaba,
Nkwagale-era nkuwulire
Emirembe gyonna.
